test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 30 Sept 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Three statements are given, followed by two conclusions numbered I and II. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

1. All flowers are white.

2. Some flowers are dark.

3. All darks are blue.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some whites are blue.

II. All darks are white.

options.text: Both conclusions I and II follow
Neither conclusion I nor II follows

solution:
Given Statements:

1. All flowers are white.

2. Some flowers are dark.

3. All darks are blue.

The least possible Venn diagram for the given statement is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/300fb953bfb44a62c2d132494790a814364f7f5d92f4b32d2b4ede2078dad0a2.png] 

**Conclusions:**

I. Some whites are blue - **True **(Because, those parts of white which are flowers and part of dark, are also the part of is blue).

II. All darks are white - False (Because, only some parts of dark which are flowers, are also part of white, so this can be a possibility but not definite).

So, the only conclusion I follow.

Hence, the correct answer is "**Option 4**".
